title: Move the tray companion into its own cdx-tray repository

needs: The tray companion (Rust, tray/) lives in its own public repository, cdx-tray, with its own CI and releases.
A cdx release no longer rebuilds the tray assets nor waits for them before publishing to npm and PyPI.
The tray CI and releases only run when the tray changes or when cdx publishes a breaking change of the tray contract.
context: Maintainer decision (2026-11-14): repository name cdx-tray; implemented directly, not delegated.

Today the tray only talks to cdx through `cdx tray status --json`; it imports no cdx code. Every cdx release rebuilds every tray target (about 3 minutes) and the npm/PyPI publish jobs wait for that build, even when the tray did not change.

`cdx tray install` downloads `cdx-tray-{version}-{target}.tar.gz` from the cdx release of the same version and verifies it against the release-archives.json checksum ledger. After the move it must pick the newest cdx-tray release that supports the installed cdx schema major.
cdx-tray is public: copy clean files without importing this repository's history, and keep every value generic (no host, account or path specific to one installation).
acceptance_criteria: AC1: `cdx tray status --json` keeps its existing `schema` (name, major, minor); a test pins the JSON shape per version, so a change fails until the minor (added keys) or major (removed or renamed keys) is bumped.
AC2: The public cdx-tray repository builds, tests and releases the tray assets with their checksum ledger, on its own changes or when cdx announces a new schema major.

AC3: `cdx tray install` installs the newest cdx-tray release that supports the installed contract, verified against that release's checksum ledger; an unsupported contract is refused with a clear update message.
AC4: cdx-manager no longer contains tray/ nor the tray asset workflow; its publish jobs no longer wait for tray assets; earlier cdx releases keep their published tray assets.
AC5: The tray shows an update message instead of failing when cdx reports a contract it does not know.

product.title: cdx-tray, the tray companion released on its own
product.overview: The menu-bar/tray companion becomes its own small public project with a versioned JSON contract to cdx, so each side releases at its own pace.
goals: Faster cdx releases: no tray rebuild and no publish wait.
A tray that only rebuilds when it changes or when the contract does.
A safe install path that never pairs an incompatible tray and cdx.

backlog_items.title: Version the tray contract and pin its JSON shape
problem: The tray depends on `cdx tray status --json` but nothing marks a breaking change of that output.
scope_in: Reuse the existing `schema` {name, major, minor} of the tray snapshot (1.3 today); a major bump is the breaking change.
A test pins the shape (keys and types) and fails on change unless the contract version is bumped in the same change.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: the field exists and the shape test guards it.

backlog_items.title: Create the public cdx-tray repository with its CI and releases
problem: The tray has no home of its own.
scope_in: Clean copy of tray/ (no history), licence, README in the shared short shape, CI building and testing on its own changes.
Release workflow: one asset per OS and architecture plus a checksum ledger, triggered by a tray tag or by a cdx contract announcement (repository_dispatch).
The tray keeps its existing update hint for an unknown schema major.
Privacy scan of every file and commit before the first push.
acceptance_criteria: AC2: a cdx-tray release publishes every asset with its ledger.
AC5: an unknown contract shows an update message.

backlog_items.title: Install the tray from cdx-tray releases
problem: `cdx tray install` only knows the cdx release of the same version.
scope_in: Pick the newest cdx-tray release whose supported contract range includes the installed cdx schema major; verify against its ledger; refuse otherwise with an update message.
Keep installing from the matching cdx-manager release for versions published before the move.
acceptance_criteria: AC3: install picks a compatible cdx-tray release and refuses an incompatible one.

backlog_items.title: Remove the tray from cdx-manager and announce contract changes
problem: Every cdx release still rebuilds and waits for the tray.
scope_in: Delete tray/ and the tray asset workflow; drop the publish wait in the npm and PyPI workflows.
When a release bumps `tray_contract`, notify cdx-tray (repository_dispatch).
Update the README table, docs and tray testing guide to point to cdx-tray.
acceptance_criteria: AC4: a cdx release publishes without tray jobs, and earlier releases keep their assets.

orchestration_task.title: Orchestrate the cdx-tray split
plan: Contract first (item 1), released in a cdx version so cdx-tray can rely on it.
Create cdx-tray (item 2) and publish its first release built from the same sources.
Switch `cdx tray install` (item 3), then remove the tray from cdx-manager (item 4) in the next cdx release.
Verify on a real machine: install, launch, menu refresh, and a cdx release that publishes without tray jobs.
